name: t2sales-android
description: T2 Sales — Android/iOS native shells (Capacitor WebView around the same production web app, mirrors desktop/'s Electron shell). Folder kept as 'android' from the original Android-only scaffold.

scripts.android:build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
